summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a 6-K containing its November 11, 2026 reply to B3 Letter 344/2026-SLE, confirming non-payment of amortization and remuneratory interest due November 9, 2026 on its 18th issuance debentures (R$1.2 billion across BRKMA8 and BRKMB8 series), rendering the notes in default. Payment is suspended under the extrajudicial reorganization petition filed August 24, 2026; the 2nd Bankruptcy and Judicial Reorganization Court of São Paulo ratified a 120-day stay on August 27, 2026, suspending enforceability and limitation periods. The Brazilian extrajudicial reorganization maps to a US pre-packaged Chapter 11-style restructuring. Watch creditor negotiations, stay expiry, and debenture acceleration risk.
